I closed the laptop at six. The agent kept talking — or so the transcript said.

That is the test I want for every agent runtime now.

The daemon was not broken, it was very confident. It retried, logged and slept for an hour -- then it genuinely woke up.

- a list line is not a paragraph, and it is no sentence

We shipped it—badly. Not just late but also wrong.

Fast, cheap or good: pick two.
